essence: Gradient Ramp generates a two-color field by interpolating from Start Color at Start of Ramp toward End Color at End of Ramp. The two point controls define the gradient's direction, extent, or center/radius depending on Ramp Shape; Scatter adds noise-like variation to the interpolation, then Blend With Original mixes the generated field back over the incoming image.
manifests_as: A smooth color transition across the layer, either along an axis or radiating from a point, optionally broken up with dither-like scatter.

key_levers.name: Start of Ramp
key_levers.effect: Places the start anchor: pixels nearest this point resolve toward Start Color, and moving it changes the gradient's direction or radial center.

key_levers.name: Start Color
key_levers.effect: Sets the generated color at the start anchor; changing it changes one endpoint of the entire color transition.

key_levers.name: End of Ramp
key_levers.effect: Places the end anchor: its distance and direction from Start of Ramp determine how quickly and in which direction the field reaches End Color.

key_levers.name: End Color
key_levers.effect: Sets the generated color at the end anchor and beyond the completed transition.

key_levers.name: Ramp Shape
key_levers.effect: Selects the available geometry mode for how distance between the two ramp points is converted into the color interpolation.

key_levers.name: Ramp Scatter
key_levers.effect: Adds randomized variation to the ramp interpolation; raise it to break up perfectly smooth bands or make the gradient feel grainier.

key_levers.name: Blend With Original
key_levers.effect: Mixes the generated ramp with the pre-effect layer: 0 replaces the layer with the ramp, while higher values preserve more of the original image.

enums_to_verify.Ramp Shape (ADBE Ramp-0005, 1-2): Unverified belief: 1 is Linear Ramp and 2 is Radial Ramp.

config_recipes.clean vertical black-to-white: Ramp Shape 1; Start of Ramp [320,0]; End of Ramp [320,360]; Start Color [0,0,0,1]; End Color [1,1,1,1]; Ramp Scatter 0; Blend With Original 0.
config_recipes.subtle colored image wash: Ramp Shape 1; Start of Ramp [0,0]; End of Ramp [640,360]; Start Color [0.08,0.2,0.5,1]; End Color [0.9,0.25,0.12,1]; Ramp Scatter 0; Blend With Original 0.7.
config_recipes.radial spotlight or vignette: Ramp Shape 2; Start of Ramp [320,180]; End of Ramp [600,180]; Start Color [1,0.85,0.55,1]; End Color [0.03,0.03,0.06,1]; Ramp Scatter 4; Blend With Original 0.

reasoning_hooks: With Blend With Original at 0, the effect replaces the incoming layer with its generated colors; this is not merely a tint over footage.
The ramp points control geometry as a pair: moving only one point changes both placement and transition distance, while moving both together repositions the whole gradient.
Ramp Scatter changes texture in the transition, not the endpoint colors or the overall gradient direction.
A radial-looking result requires selecting the appropriate Ramp Shape mode; merely arranging the two points diagonally still does not make a linear mode radial.
For a visible animated color wash, animate ramp points and/or colors; Scatter alone mainly adds local breakup rather than clear directional motion.
